territories.name: Namibia
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. The Republic of Namibia levies its own value-added tax under the Value-Added Tax Act, 2000 (Act No. 10 of 2000), administered by the Namibia Revenue Agency, at 15 per cent (section 6(1)) on taxable supplies by registered persons, on imported goods and on imported services.
